body: UK Bank Launches Tokenized Deposits as Midnight Foundation CEO Signs Basic Agreement with Japanese Major

sourceReview.reason: Composite BigGo Finance headline conflates Monument Bank's already-announced November 16 tokenized savings launch with a purported separate Japanese-major basic agreement. Midnight Foundation's full original November 16 release confirms Monument's 5.2% AER, 12-month product and up-to-GBP250m first-phase cap, but does not substantiate the claimed Japanese-major agreement. The same Monument launch is already tracked in publish/inbox/2026-11-16-monument-bank-partners-with-midnight-to-launch-uk-s-first-tokenized-deposits.json. No full original source establishing a distinct November 19 event or the Japanese agreement was verified. Keep unpublished; retry no sooner than 2026-11-19T10:10:56Z.
